findings.detail: Thirteen extracted candidates were audited against ten assigned validated Markdown units.

All fifteen substantive sections across the three future-vault notes have exact note, section and reviewed evidence bindings.
SRC-0009, SRC-0036 and SRC-0039 provide research, supervisory guidance and voluntary framework context only.
